headline: CNN, Axios, the Financial Times and Forbes have joined Google's News AI pilot, in which Google pays news publishers for content it uses in AI features.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a widely watched pay-for-content deal, but terms are undisclosed.
importance_line: Newsrooms are paid for AI use of their reporting and readers will see AI overviews built on it, but the sums and the Google products that will use CNN's content were not disclosed.
summary: The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports that CNN signed a multiyear deal giving Google expanded rights to use its journalism in AI products in exchange for payment, with terms undisclosed. Google's own post of 15 Oct 2026 says more than 400 publications now take part in its News AI pilot, with newer partners including Axios, CNN, the Financial Times and Forbes, and that it pays them for content used in features such as article overviews and audio briefings.
notes: Reuters original blocked; credited to the Atlanta Journal-Constitution, which read the CNN and Google announcement; Google blog also read.
